simple.summary: אֲמִתַּי (ʼĂmittay) means Amittai , an Israelite First listed occurrence: 2Kgs 14 25.

definitions.full: H573. Amittay אֲמִתַּי proper name, masculine ( TRUE , from אֱמֶת by adjective affix י -) father of the prophet Jonah 2Kin 14:25 ; Jonah 1:1 .
